title: Flexible-length Text Infilling for Discrete Diffusion Models
tldr_zh: DDOT 用 sample-level OT 位置耦合让离散扩散同时去噪 token 值与位置，首次实现无 ground-truth 位置数据的灵活长度/位置文本填充。
tldr_en: DDOT jointly denoises token values and positions with sample-level OT coupling, enabling flexible-length text infilling in discrete diffusion without ground-truth positions.
